mentions.note: leading in 1924 photo; later a Vice President of Belgrave

photos.c: MICKY PYER (22), competing in a 2 miles team race against Ashcombe AC and TVH in 1924. Leading is H.W. Ellsey (Ashcombe) later to become a Vice President of Belgrave. No. 20 in the rear is Bert Footer.
